QuestInfo.name: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies
QuestInfo.0: I should go see Bruce in Henesys...
QuestInfo.1:
I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying the monsters and animals in general in Henesys. His bright smile and the easy-going demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding a clue on his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this...

QuestInfo.2: I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter?

0.0: Hey there, kid. Yes, you! I am a scientist that specializes in the field of monsters and animals in this world. If you have any time available, would you mind helping the old man out?

yes.0: Thank you. I have been currently studying the mushroom monsters, and speaking of mushroom monsters, this reminds me of something.
yes.1: Years ago, my daughter and I went out of town in search of research materials. While we were busy excavating, we were ambushed by an enormous mushroom monster.
yes.2: By the time I regained my consciousness, I had been severely battered and bruised, while my daughter was nowhere to be found. Ever since the incident, I have been studying the mushroom monsters in hopes for finding some clues for my daughter's whereabouts.
yes.3: Oh, I'm rambling on again. Anyway, I would appreciate it a great deal if you can get me #b10 Mushroom Spores and 40 Orange Mushroom Caps#k. Good luck!

no.0: I would appreciate a good deal if you could help me out, but alas, you are busy.

1.0: You brought them all here! Thank you thank you! I shall start studying these samples carefully. Oh, I almost forgot to reward you for your hard work.

yes.0: Here's a small gift to you. This should help you on your journey. I will see you around.

item.0: I don't think you have collected all the items I requested. These are the ones you'll need: #b10 Mushroom Spores#k and #b40 Orange Mushroom Caps#k.
